Downloads: 33,441
File: StatCalc_10.1.zip (6.4 KB)

StatCalc is a plugin for calculating how your characters ratings and percentages will change after increases or reductions to different stats.

Usage:
Show and update window: /statcalc
Show and reset window: /statcalc reset
Toggle window: /statcalc toggle
Switch to English: /statcalc english
Switch to German: /statcalc german

The default language should match your client however I dont have a multilingual client to test this. The default language can also be overriden with a configuration option in the source.

Downloads: 22,927
File: ItemCalc_10.zip (7.9 KB)

ItemCalc is a plugin for testing the expected characteristics of items.

DO NOT /bug Turbine about item problems unless youre absolutely sure the error is not in the plugin. Im rarely sure. Also dont let weapons drive you insane.

The first column of numbers displays the typical amount of a given stat on an item of that level. The second column of numbers displays the amount of the item budget that the stat is taking.

Usage:
show window: /itemcalc
toggle debugging: /itemcalc debug
reset window: /itemcalc reset
